design_philosophy: A simple, modern, and highly functional data mapping dashboard. Prioritizes clarity, data density, and clear visual hierarchy for comparing parsed schedule data against raw Excel inputs. The UI is calm and analytical, using light colors and strict grid structures.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: The 'Control Room Grid' - optimized for density, correlation, and scanability. Uses exact cell alignment for split-screen comparison.

dashboard_structure.header: h-16 border-b border-slate-200 px-6 flex items-center justify-between bg-white z-50 sticky top-0
dashboard_structure.panel: flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 h-full border-r border-slate-200 last:border-r-0 bg-white
dashboard_structure.panel_header: h-12 border-b border-slate-200 px-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50/50

grid_components.grid_cell: border border-slate-200 p-2 min-h-[80px] align-top transition-colors relative
grid_components.block_item: rounded-md p-2 mb-1 text-xs border-l-2 last:mb-0 cursor-pointer

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#E2E8F0), no shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and subtle shadow-sm.
surface_strategies.modals: Crystal Glass overlay (bg-slate-900/20 backdrop-blur-sm). Modal body: solid white, sharp corners (rounded-lg), 1px border.
surface_strategies.excel_preview: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Visible skeleton, border-collapse, rigid structure.

interaction_and_motion.hover_states: Subtle background shifts (bg-white -> bg-slate-50). Elements MUST have clear hover states.
interaction_and_motion.focus_states: High contrast ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-1).
interaction_and_motion.sync_highlight: When selecting a block in the schedule, the corresponding raw cell in the Excel view instantly highlights with a light blue background and border.
interaction_and_motion.transitions: Fast and snappy. transition-all duration-150 ease-in-out.

custom_rules.tables: Avoid generic tables for the schedule. Build a custom CSS Grid or standard HTML table with strict width constraints to emulate Excel.
custom_rules.buttons: Flat design, rounded-md. Primary: solid blue. Secondary: outline slate. Ghost: transparent with slate hover.
custom_rules.status_badges: Use semantic colors (success/warning/error) with 10% opacity background and solid text. No icons in badges to save space.

media_and_icons.icon_usage: Stroke width 1.5, size 16px for inline, 20px for headers. Use for toolbars and actions.
media_and_icons.empty_states: Do not use placeholder images. Use large centered Lucide icons (e.g., FileSpreadsheet, UploadCloud) wrapped in a soft circular background.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Keep parser logic strictly in FastAPI. The frontend (React) should be a dumb visualizer and editor.
instructions_to_main_agent.split_screen_sync: Implement a context or Zustand store to hold 'selectedOriginalCellRef' (e.g., 'C4'). Both the Schedule grid and Excel grid listen to this. Clicking either side updates the state, causing the other side to scroll into view and highlight.
instructions_to_main_agent.fuzzy_matching: The UI editor must include an autocomplete combobox for Subjects and Teachers. If a subject isn't found, allow custom entry but flag it visually as 'Unknown' (grey or red).
instructions_to_main_agent.data_model: Blocks must have state flags: 'confirmed', 'inferred', 'error'. Map these directly to semantic colors (green, amber, red border-left).
